packs.name: 给调度打电话
packs.intro: 打给调度问货在哪、报延误、问预计到达时间。先报名字和柜号/单号，再说问题。

dialog.t: Hi, this is Steve at the Upland yard.
dialog.zh: 你好，我是 Upland 堆场的 Steve。

dialog.t: Hey Steve, what do you need?
I'm checking on a load for container TGHU eight six one.
dialog.zh: 我想查一下 TGHU 861 开头那个柜子的货。

dialog.t: Let me look. That driver is running late.
dialog.zh: 我查一下。那个司机晚了。

dialog.t: Do you have an ETA?
He should be there around two thirty.
Okay. Can you give me his truck number?
dialog.zh: 好的。能给我他的车号吗？

dialog.t: Truck four twelve. Driver's name is Mike.
Got it. Please call me if anything changes.
dialog.zh: 收到。有变化请给我打电话。

dialog.t: Will do. Thanks.

phrases.t: Where's my load right now?
What's the ETA on that driver?
The driver hasn't shown up yet.
We have a delay on our end.
The container isn't ready for pickup yet.
Can you send another driver?
Is this load still on for today?
I need the pickup number for this load.
phrases.zh: 我需要这票货的提货号。

phrases.t: The appointment was moved to tomorrow morning.
Can you text me the details?
phrases.zh: 能把详情发短信给我吗？

phrases.t: Who's the driver on this one?
Let me call you right back.
Sorry, I'm on another call. One second.
phrases.zh: 抱歉，我在接另一个电话，稍等。

phrases.t: Thanks for the update.
phrases.zh: 谢谢你告诉我最新情况。

packs.name: 对讲机用语
packs.intro: 对讲机要短：先叫对方再报自己，说完等回复。copy/10-4 表示收到，stand by 表示稍等。

dialog.t: Steve, this is Mark. Do you copy?
Go ahead, Mark.
I need you at row C. A driver is waiting.
dialog.zh: 你去 C 排，有司机在等。

dialog.t: Copy that. Heading there now.
Check the seal before he leaves.
dialog.zh: 他走之前检查一下封条。

dialog.t: Say again? You broke up.
Check the seal before he leaves.
dialog.zh: 他走之前检查一下封条。

dialog.t: 10-4. Will check the seal.
Stand by, I'm almost there.
Seal is good. Driver is clear to go. Over.
dialog.zh: 封条没问题，司机可以走了。完毕。

phrases.t: Copy that.
Go ahead.
Stand by.
Say again?
phrases.note: 对讲机里比 What? 更标准

phrases.t: You're breaking up.
Loud and clear.
Mark, this is Steve. Do you copy?
On my way.
I'm at the gate now.
Need a hand at row five.
Negative, that container's not here.
Affirmative.
All clear.
Over.

packs.name: 报柜号/拼字母
packs.intro: 柜号 = 4 个字母 + 6 位数字 + 1 位校验码。字母用北约字母读（C as in Charlie），数字一位一位读，0 读 zero。

dialog.t: What's the container number?
C-S-Q-U, three zero five four three eight, three.
Was that B or D?
Neither. C as in Charlie, S as in Sierra.
dialog.zh: 都不是。C 是 Charlie 的 C，S 是 Sierra 的 S。

dialog.t: Q as in Quebec, U as in Uniform.
dialog.zh: Q 是 Quebec 的 Q，U 是 Uniform 的 U。

dialog.t: Okay. Read me the numbers again.
Three, zero, five, four, three, eight. Check digit three.
Got it. CSQU three zero five four three eight, three.
That's correct.

phrases.t: C-S-Q-U, three zero five four three eight, three.
phrases.note: 最后一位是校验码，前面停一下

phrases.t: M-S-C-U, four seven two one nine zero, six.
T-G-H-U, eight six one five two seven, two.
H-L-X-U, six one two zero zero four, seven.
M as in Mike, S as in Sierra, C as in Charlie, U as in Uniform.
T as in Tango, G as in Golf, H as in Hotel.
B as in Bravo, not D as in Delta.
phrases.zh: 是 Bravo 的 B，不是 Delta 的 D。

phrases.t: M as in Mike, N as in November.
F as in Foxtrot, S as in Sierra.
A as in Alpha, E as in Echo, I as in India.
K as in Kilo, X as in X-ray, Y as in Yankee.
O as in Oscar, P as in Papa, R as in Romeo.
J as in Juliett, L as in Lima, V as in Victor.
W as in Whiskey, Z as in Zulu.
The check digit is three.
Let me read that back to you.

packs.name: 进出闸口
packs.intro: 在闸口和闸口员（gate clerk）核对订舱号、封条号、车架，拿 EIR（设备交接单）。

dialog.t: Morning. Pick up or drop off?
Drop off. Empty return.
Container number?
M-S-C-U, four seven two one nine zero, six.
Is it on your own chassis?
dialog.zh: 是在你们自己的车架上吗？

dialog.t: No, it's a pool chassis.
Any damage I should know about?
dialog.zh: 有没有需要我知道的损坏？

dialog.t: There's a small dent on the left side.
Okay, I'll note it on the EIR.
dialog.zh: 好，我在 EIR 上记一下。

dialog.t: Can I get a copy of the EIR?
dialog.zh: 能给我一份 EIR 吗？

dialog.t: Sure. Go to row twelve.

phrases.t: I'm here to pick up a load.
Here's the booking number.
The seal number is four eight two two one nine.
Can you check the seal number again?
phrases.zh: 能再核对一下封条号吗？

phrases.t: Is the container released?
The system shows a hold on this one.
phrases.zh: 系统显示这个柜子被扣了。

phrases.t: Which row should I go to?
I need a chassis for this container.
phrases.zh: 这个柜子我需要一个车架。

phrases.t: Can I get a copy of the EIR?
phrases.zh: 能给我一份 EIR 吗？
phrases.note: EIR = equipment interchange receipt 设备交接单

phrases.t: Please note the damage on the EIR.
phrases.zh: 请把损坏记在 EIR 上。

phrases.t: Is it loaded or empty?
The gate closes at five today.
Pull up to the next lane, please.
You're all set.

packs.name: 报告柜子损坏
packs.intro: 发现柜子/车架有损坏：说清位置（哪一面）、类型（凹痕、破洞、锈、门变形、封条断）、已拍照。

dialog.t: Hey Mark, I found some damage on a container.
dialog.zh: Mark，我发现一个柜子有损坏。

dialog.t: Which one?
T-G-H-U, eight six one five two seven, two.
What kind of damage?
There's a hole in the roof, near the back.
And the right door is bent. It won't close all the way.
Did you take pictures?
Yes, I took six photos from all sides.
Good. Send them to me and put it on hold.
Will do. I'll tag it right now.

phrases.t: There's a dent on the left side panel.
There's a hole in the roof.
The floor is damaged inside.
There's heavy rust near the bottom.
The door is bent and won't close.
The seal is broken.
The seal number doesn't match the paperwork.
The door handle is missing.
One of the tires is flat.
The light on the trailer isn't working.
I took photos from all four sides.
I'll send you the pictures now.
Was this damage already there?
Should I put it on hold?
It looks like it happened in transit.
phrases.zh: 看起来是运输途中弄的。

packs.name: 指挥倒车与安全
packs.intro: 指挥司机倒车靠位，口令要短、要大声；同时提醒安全：反光背心、轮挡、注意脚下。

dialog.t: Okay, back it up slow.
How much room do I have?
About ten feet. Keep coming.
Cut it a little to the left.
Straighten out. You're good.
Easy, easy. Stop!
Am I in?
You're in. Set your brakes, please.
I'm going to chock the wheels.
Please put on your vest if you step out.
Got it. Thanks, man.

phrases.t: Back it up slow.
Keep coming.
Stop right there!
Turn your wheel to the right.
Pull forward and try again.
You've got about five feet.
Watch the pole on your right.
Set your brakes, please.
Chock the wheels before you unhook.
Please wear your safety vest.
Watch your step.
Stay in your truck, please.
I can't see you in your mirror.
phrases.zh: 我在你后视镜里看不到你。
phrases.note: 提醒自己站在司机看得到的地方

phrases.t: Hold on, someone's walking behind you.
phrases.zh: 等一下，有人在你后面走。

phrases.t: Slow down in the yard, please.

packs.name: 和司机打交道
packs.intro: 司机常问：放哪、去哪个门、单据、要等多久。回答要清楚，必要时指方向、帮他打电话问。

dialog.t: Hey, where do I drop this trailer?
Can I see your paperwork?
Here you go.
This goes to door eighteen, not twelve.
dialog.zh: 这个去 18 号门，不是 12 号。

dialog.t: They told me twelve.
It was changed this morning. Sorry about that.
How long is the wait?
About thirty minutes. They're unloading another truck.
dialog.zh: 大概三十分钟，他们在卸另一辆车。

dialog.t: Can I drop it and go?
Yes. Drop it in spot forty and leave your empty there.
dialog.zh: 可以。放 40 号位，把你的空车留那。

dialog.t: Sounds good.

phrases.t: Where are you headed?
Can I see your paperwork?
You're at the wrong door.
Go to door eighteen, on your left.
Drop it in spot forty.
Is this a live unload or a drop?
phrases.note: live unload = 司机等着卸完；drop = 放下就走

phrases.t: You'll have to wait about thirty minutes.
They're still loading your trailer.
I'll call the office and check.
phrases.zh: 我打电话问一下办公室。

phrases.t: Your load isn't ready yet.
You need to check in at the office first.
Please take your paperwork to the window.
Sorry for the wait.
You're good to go.
Drive safe.

packs.name: 仓库收发货
packs.intro: 收发货要核对预约、BOL（提单）、件数；有短少/多出/破损（OS&D）要写在单上再签字，签收后给 POD。

dialog.t: I have a delivery for door six.
dialog.zh: 我有一票送到 6 号门。

dialog.t: Do you have an appointment?
Yeah, ten o'clock. Here's the BOL.
It says twenty pallets.
I only count eighteen.
Are you sure? They loaded twenty.
dialog.zh: 你确定？他们装了 20 托。

dialog.t: Let's count them again together.
Still eighteen. I'll write two short on the BOL.
dialog.zh: 还是 18。我在 BOL 上写短少两托。

dialog.t: Also, one pallet has a crushed box.
dialog.zh: 还有一托有个箱子压坏了。

dialog.t: Okay. Where do I sign?
Sign here, and here's your copy.

phrases.t: What time is your appointment?
Can I see the bill of lading?
Back into door six, please.
How many pallets do you have?
The count doesn't match.
We're two pallets short.
We have one extra pallet.
This box is damaged.
I'll note it on the BOL.
Please sign here.
Here's your POD.
phrases.note: POD = proof of delivery 签收证明

phrases.t: You missed your appointment.
We can fit you in after lunch.
phrases.zh: 午饭后可以给你插进来。

phrases.t: The seal was intact when it arrived.
We're done. You can pull out.

packs.name: 和主管沟通
packs.intro: 和主管谈排班、加班、请假、报问题。先说事，再给原因；没听懂就礼貌地请他再解释。

dialog.t: Hey Mark, do you have a minute?
Sure, what's up?
I'd like to take next Friday off.
I have a doctor's appointment.
Should be fine. Put it in the system.
dialog.zh: 应该没问题，在系统里提交。

dialog.t: Thanks. Also, is there overtime this weekend?
dialog.zh: 谢谢。还有，这周末有加班吗？

dialog.t: Yes, Saturday from six to two.
I can do Saturday.
Great. And remember the new photo rules.
Sorry, what do you mean by the new rules?
dialog.zh: 不好意思，新规定是指什么？

dialog.t: Four sides plus the seal, every time.
Got it. Thanks for explaining.

phrases.t: Do you have a minute?
Can I take next Friday off?
I need to leave an hour early today.
phrases.zh: 我今天需要早走一小时。

phrases.t: Is there any overtime this week?
I can stay late if you need me.
Can I switch shifts with Carlos?
phrases.zh: 我能和 Carlos 换班吗？

phrases.t: What's my schedule next week?
I want to report a problem.
The camera on my phone isn't working well.
phrases.zh: 我手机的相机不太好用。

phrases.t: Sorry, could you explain that again?
phrases.zh: 不好意思，能再解释一下吗？

phrases.t: Just to be clear, you want me to do this first?
phrases.zh: 确认一下，你是要我先做这个？

phrases.t: Which one is more important?
I'm running a little late. Be there in fifteen.
phrases.zh: 我会晚一点，十五分钟到。

phrases.t: I finished row C. What's next?
phrases.zh: C 排做完了，接下来做什么？

phrases.t: Thanks, I appreciate it.

packs.name: 工作邮件和短信
packs.intro: 工作短信/邮件：一句一件事，写清柜号、时间、地点，附照片就说 see attached。也练习把它们读出来。

dialog.t: Hi Mark, quick update on container CSQU three zero five.
dialog.zh: Mark 你好，关于 CSQU305 开头的柜子简单更新一下。

dialog.t: It was delivered at ten fifteen this morning.
dialog.zh: 今早十点十五分已送达。

dialog.t: Please see the attached photos.
Thanks. Any damage?
Small dent on the right side. Photo three.
dialog.zh: 右侧有小凹痕，看第三张照片。

dialog.t: Okay. Did the driver sign?
Yes. The signed POD is attached too.
dialog.zh: 签了，签好的 POD 也附上了。

dialog.t: Perfect. Thanks, Steve.
No problem. Let me know if you need anything else.
dialog.zh: 不客气，还需要什么告诉我。

phrases.t: Please see the attached photos.
Container MSCU four seven two was delivered at nine.
phrases.zh: MSCU472 开头的柜子九点送达。

phrases.t: The driver checked in at two thirty.
The trailer is parked in spot forty.
The seal number matches the paperwork.
I found damage on the left door.
This container is still on hold.
Just a quick reminder about tomorrow's pickup.
phrases.zh: 提醒一下明天提柜的事。

phrases.t: Can you confirm the pickup time?
phrases.zh: 能确认一下提柜时间吗？

phrases.t: Sorry for the late reply.
I'll follow up this afternoon.
Let me know if you have any questions.
Thanks for your help.
Running ten minutes late. Sorry.

packs.name: 休息室闲聊
packs.intro: 和同事随便聊：周末、球赛、天气、吃的。不用说很多，会问一句、接一句就很自然。

dialog.t: Hey Steve, how was your weekend?
dialog.zh: 嘿 Steve，周末过得怎么样？

dialog.t: Pretty good. I went hiking up near Mount Baldy.
dialog.zh: 挺好的，去 Mount Baldy 那边爬山了。

dialog.t: Nice. Was it cold up there?
A little, but the view was great. How about you?
dialog.zh: 有点冷，但风景很好。你呢？

dialog.t: Just watched the game. The Dodgers won!
Yeah, I saw the score. Good game.
dialog.zh: 嗯，我看到比分了，打得好。

dialog.t: It's going to be hot again today.
I know. Make sure you drink water.
What did you bring for lunch?
Just some fried rice. Want to try some?
Sure, smells good!

phrases.t: How was your weekend?
Did you do anything fun?
Not much, just relaxed at home.
Did you catch the game last night?
Who do you think is going to win?
It's so hot today.
I heard it might rain this weekend.
The traffic on the 10 was terrible.
phrases.note: 南加州说高速前面加 the

phrases.t: What are you having for lunch?
Have you tried that taco place on Foothill?
phrases.zh: 你去过 Foothill 上那家塔可店吗？

phrases.t: That sounds great.
Any plans for the holiday?
Long day, huh?
See you tomorrow.
